time.$comment: The time field AND the columns it opens. One component tier for both, because `--pct-{component}-…` names the ENTRYPOINT and `PctTimeColumns` ships inside `@pacit/components/time` — the date's tier and its calendar, one entrypoint over (req-token-names, check-tokens point 3; 0086 §6).

fg.$description: Text colour of the time field.

border.$description: Edge colour of the time field.

border-hover.$description: Edge colour of the time field on hover.

border-focus.$description: Edge colour of the time field when focused.

border-invalid.$description: Edge colour of the time field when invalid.

fg-invalid.$description: Text colour of the time field when invalid.

border-warning.$description: Edge colour of the time field under a warning (0087).

fg-warning.$description: Text colour of the warning line (0087).

bg-disabled.$description: Background of the time field while disabled.

fg-disabled.$description: Text colour of the time field while disabled.

border-disabled.$description: Edge colour of the time field while disabled.

radius.$description: Corner radius of the time field.

font-size.$description: Font size of the time field.

font-size-sm.$description: Font size of the time field at size sm.

font-size-lg.$description: Font size of the time field at size lg.

padding-y.$description: Vertical padding of the time field.

padding-x.$description: Horizontal padding of the time field.

padding-y-sm.$description: Vertical padding of the time field at size sm.

padding-x-sm.$description: Horizontal padding of the time field at size sm.

padding-y-lg.$description: Vertical padding of the time field at size lg.

padding-x-lg.$description: Horizontal padding of the time field at size lg.

target-min.$description: Touch-target floor of the time field.

time.$comment-toggle: The button that opens the columns. It is the one thing in the row a finger aims at, so its size is a floor rather than a fixed number — `max()` against `target-min` in the sheet.
time.$comment-icon: The box the toggle's clock sits in. One number, because `req-api-icons` makes the box the component's and the drawing the consumer's.

toggle-radius.$description: Corner radius of the clock toggle.

toggle-fg.$description: Text colour of the clock toggle.

toggle-bg-hover.$description: Background of the clock toggle on hover.

panel-gap.$description: Gap between the columns of the panel.

time.$comment-column: One column — a listbox of one field of the time, which scrolls. Its height is a window of about seven rows at size md; the rows scale with the field's size and the window does not, so a smaller field shows a row more and a larger one a row less.

column-min-width.$description: Minimum width of a column — a day-period word wider than two digits widens its own column.

time.$comment-option: One row of a column. Everything a column draws is this row, so a theme that resizes it resizes the whole panel (req-api-size).

option-height-sm.$description: Height of a row at size sm.

option-height-lg.$description: Height of a row at size lg.

option-font-size-sm.$description: Font size of a row at size sm.

option-font-size-lg.$description: Font size of a row at size lg.

option-bg-hover.$description: Background of a row on hover.

option-bg-selected.$description: Background of a row when selected.

option-fg-selected.$description: Text colour of a row when selected.

option-font-weight-selected.$description: Font weight of a row when selected.

option-fg-disabled.$description: Text colour of a row while disabled.
